question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **Decieve**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **correct spelling** and **meaning** of the chosen option are as follows:

 
 
• **Deceive: **to try to make somebody believe something that is not true
 
 

Therefore, the incorrectly spelled word is **Decieve.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Gothic: **the extinct language of the Goths.
 
• **Neutron: **one of the three types of particles that form all atoms.
 
• **Frosty: **very cold.
